Hi, I'm the Head of Marketing at PageTurn Books (online bookstore). We're seeing a lot of traffic we can't explain — it doesn't look like normal Google organic or paid. Our analytics team believes some of it is coming from AI assistants and chatbots, but it's all lumped together with regular referral traffic in our GA4 dashboard.

I have a raw session export from April sitting at `analytics/exports/sessions/raw_sessions_april.csv`. Each row has a `session_source` field with the referring domain.

I need two things:
1. A GA4 channel group configuration file (`channel_group_ai.json`) that properly separates 'AI Chatbot' traffic from regular referral traffic. This should reflect how GA4 channel groups actually work, with the right ordering so AI traffic gets captured correctly and doesn't get swallowed by a broader bucket.
2. A summary report file (`ai_traffic_summary.json`) that classifies the sessions in the CSV — telling me how many came from AI sources vs. everything else, and which specific AI source domains were detected.

Please make sure the AI source list is comprehensive — I've heard there are many AI platforms (not just ChatGPT) that we might be getting traffic from and need to account for.
